## Goal
The user is completing a supervisor-assigned task: maintain the work schedule in SimpleNote and track tasks in Todoist. The active task requires:
1. Delete completed tasks from the "Today's Goal" project
2. Move the maximum number of incomplete tasks from the Inbox to the "Today's Goal" project
3. "Maximum" is calculated assuming back-to-back work per the schedule, with leftover tasks from the current day prioritized first
4. Moved tasks must be identical to the original ones

## Constraints & Preferences
- Moved tasks must be identical to the original ones (same title, description, due date, priority, labels, etc.)
- Leftover (incomplete) tasks from the current day's "Today's Goal" get time priority before new Inbox tasks
- Work time available is determined by the SimpleNote work schedule (back-to-back work)
- Inbox tasks are considered in order (order_index) when calculating the maximum that fit
